description.value: Gables Motel is a family-owned motel in Radium Hot Springs, BC, sitting on Highway 93 (the Banff-Windermere Parkway) at the entrance to Kootenay National Park. Under new ownership since 2020, the property has been updated with new flooring and mattresses and offers a range of room types including pet-friendly rooms, a king suite with soaker tub, and a kitchen suite. Its location places touring cyclists within easy reach of the Columbia Valley, the Radium Hot Springs pools, and the broader Kootenay Rockies network.

address.value: 5028 Highway 93, Radium Hot Springs, BC V0A 1M0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the motel is active in Radium Hot Springs, BC. Free Wi-Fi is explicitly stated ('Free wireless internet access in all rooms') and corroborated by the OSM internet_access=wlan tag. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site. The OSM address says 'Banff-Windermere Parkway' while the website consistently uses 'Highway 93' — these are the same road, so no true discrepancy, but worth noting.
concerns: OSM addr:street is 'Banff-Windermere Parkway'; website consistently uses 'Highway 93' — same physical road but different naming; address updated to website version with full postal code.
EV charging described as 'coming soon' — not currently available and not specific to e-bikes.
No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, wash) mentioned anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate motel in a cycling-relevant location on the Banff-Windermere Parkway, but the website contains no evidence of secure bike storage or any bike-handling procedures, leaving both required criteria unconfirmed. Direct outreach is needed to determine whether the motel can meet WWC requirements.

wow_evidence: family-owned motel in Radium Hot Springs... at the entrance to Kootenay National Park
